text: An octave is the distance between two of the same note. It's called an octave because one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, octave. I like you to practice your octaves with your left hand. I'd also like you to practice your octaves with the fifth of that chord. For instance, in the C chord, one, three, five. This is called the fifth because one, two, three, four, five in the C scale. With E it's the A, with E it's the B, with F it's the C, with G it's the D, and with A it's the E. This will give you a solid bass line as you create music.
